name: html-form-submit-button-class-background-survives-cascade
description: A form's native submit button whose fill comes from an author CSS class (not an inline style attribute) keeps that background as native core/button color support -- baked inline the same way text color already is -- instead of being dropped and left to lose the cascade to WordPress's unlayered wp-element-button default.

source_reference.notes: Regression fixture for the button-background-cascade defect: a class-owned flat background-color on a form submit control was unconditionally excluded from native block style attrs (StyleResolver::classOwnedBackgroundPaintDeclarations), so nothing but a secondary CSS-cascade repair stood between the author's fill and the theme's default button background. See #1894/#1896.

legacy_comparison.reason: Native button color-support fidelity for form submit controls is a PHP transformer behavior with no legacy equivalent.
